Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Delivery Period: Items should process and dispatch to VSSC within 4 months from the date of intimation. The entire order shall be executed within two years from the date o f receipt of PO. 1. Work should be carried out in presence of VSSC personal. 2. EPDM 512E grade rubber based material is to be used for the processing of P-Profile Gasket. 3. As per VSSC composition and procedure, rubber compounding to be done in Kneader (Capacity : 25 liter or better) and final two roll mill rubber mixing at company site. 4. Single screw Extruder (Barrel Length:50 cm or better) should be used for extruding the gasket as per our procedure. 5. Autoclave (Size:6000 mm length x 350 mm diameter) should be available for autoclaving the g asket as per our procedure. 6. Processing shall be carried out in a single lot/ part of 25 No’s within 4 months from t he date of intimation from VSSC. 7. Final products should be supplied within 3 months from the date of intimation from VSSC. 8. Product with cut, tears, blow holes and under cure should not supply.

9. Products should have very good surface finish. 10. Dimensions measurement as mentioned in the indent/drawing to be taken by the party and to be reported in mm. 11. Party should ensure the all the dimensions are within the specification. 12. All the finished p-profile gaskets should send sent to VSSC stores. 13. 500 gram rubber compound should hand over to VSSC engineers for the qualification of rubbe r compound. 14. Work should be complete within two years from the receipt of the PO. 15. Specification of product is as per the attached drawing. Thickness of the product is very critical . So the thickness of product is uniform and should be within the specification. 16. Product with blow holes, cut mark and undulations are not accepted. 17. Products to be packed in polythene covers individually with proper label. 18. Rubber compounding, extrusion and autoclaving are to be done as per VSSC requirement. 19. Raw material should be arranged by the company 20. Delivery Period: Items should process and dispatch to VSSC within 4 months from the date of i ntimation. The entire order shall be executed within two years from the date of receipt of PO. 21. All dimensions mentioned in the indent are in mm only. 22. Purchase order validity is 2 years from the date of release of Purchase Order. You shall quote as per the technical specification mentioned in ATC. Your bid will be ev aluated based on our required specification attached in ATC. Bidder should mandatoril y submit ATC compliance statement along with the Bid. Bids without ATC compliance s tatement will be summarily rejected. Bidders claiming Purchase Preference for Class -I local supplies shall mandatorily uploa d a certificate from OEM regarding the percentage of the local content and the details of locations at which the local value addition is made along with their bid failing to whi ch no further preference shall be granted.
